all_m_bounds.endpoint_at_mu_ge_3kappa_m2: >=3/4+1/(4m), hence the user's >=3/4 bound is valid
all_m_bounds.gap_prerequisites: unique ground state plus the exact global source inversion symmetry

finite_identity_checks.q_profile_replay_type: numeric replay of the exact analytic geometric-sum identity

interpretation: The proven 1/m gap upper bound is a collective q=0 source-coordinate statement, not evidence for eight spatial dimensions. The eight components are native root coordinates.
model_scope: The specified pure-root, pure-permutation open-chain Hamiltonian only; m>=2, J>=0, kappa>0, mu>0.

q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.finite_pole_criterion: Any claimed pole/window with total residue Z at q_n must obey Z<=3 kappa m/[8 mu sin^2(q_n/2)]; if its support has omega>=omega_min>0, also Z<=kappa/(2 omega_min).
q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.fixed_nonzero_q_under_lock_scaling: If q_n stays bounded away from 0 and mu>=3 kappa m^2, S0(n)<=1/[8m sin^2(q_n/2)] ->0.
q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.long_wave_limit: For fixed n, q_n=pi n/m ->0; mu>=3 kappa m^2 gives only S0(n)<=m/(2 pi^2 n^2)(1+o(1)), so it does not suppress the collective long-wave sector.
q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.observable: O_n,a=sum_e w_e^(n) x_e^a with normalized real open-chain w^(n)
q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.scope: This excludes finite-residue source-coordinate response at fixed nonzero q. It does not exclude spectrally dark modes, prove a dispersion law, or apply to arbitrary register observables.
q_resolved_source_coordinate_gate.static_sum: S0(n)=sum_a int S_aa(n,omega)domega <=3 kappa m/[8 mu sin^2(q_n/2)]

register_observable_scope_check.consequence: The all-observable claim 'every nonzero-q local response vanishes' is false. Only the specified source-coordinate O_w is proved to be suppressed; the Q fluctuation need not be low-frequency.
register_observable_scope_check.limiting_state: Tracing the orthogonal source labels from Omega_m leaves a classical root mixture on the registers.
